candidates.name: Control workflow and job concurrency
verified_facts: GitHub Actions supports a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress=true to cancel an older in-progress run in the same group
A fallback value can be used when an event-specific context value is unavailable
semantic_limits: Concurrency prevents duplicate workflow execution but does not execute the external Windows F-host

candidates.name: Workflow artifacts
verified_facts: GitHub provides upload-artifact and download-artifact actions for workflow artifacts
The exact runtime JSON was uploaded and retrieved with a GitHub-provided SHA-256 artifact digest
semantic_limits: An artifact proves the hosted validation run, not the unexecuted external F-host recovery

candidates.name: py_compile — Compile Python source files
verified_facts: The py_compile module compiles Python source files to byte-code
A compilation error causes the workflow command to fail
semantic_limits: Successful compilation validates syntax and import-time compilation only; it does not prove external services or data results

candidates.name: PowerShell Parser.ParseFile
verified_facts: Parser.ParseFile parses a PowerShell file and returns an AST, tokens and parse errors
The validation workflow required zero ParseError records for three guarded runner scripts
semantic_limits: A clean parse validates PowerShell syntax but does not execute the F-host scripts
